definitions.explanation: A large indoor venue used for concerts, sporting events, and other performances. Also refers specifically to the floor-level seating area closest to the stage at a concert.

examples.japanese: アリーナでライブを{観|み}た。
examples.english: I saw a concert at an arena.

examples.japanese: アリーナ{席|せき}のチケットが{当|あ}たった。
examples.english: I won tickets for arena floor seats.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}、あの{人気|にんき}バンドが{一万人|いちまんにん}{収容|しゅうよう}のアリーナでツアーの{最終|さいしゅう}{公演|こうえん}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: Next month, that popular band will hold their final tour performance at an arena that holds ten thousand people.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese concert terminology, アリーナ has two meanings: the venue itself (an arena), and the floor-level area in front of the stage (アリーナ{席|せき}). Getting アリーナ{席|せき} is considered a lucky draw because of the proximity to the performers.

CONCERT VENUE HIERARCHY:
Japanese concerts are categorized by venue size:
- ライブハウス: small live house (hundreds)
- ホール: concert hall (thousands)
- アリーナ: arena (5,000-20,000)
- ドーム: dome stadium (30,000+)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アリーナ{席|せき}: arena floor seats
- アリーナツアー: arena tour
- アリーナ{公演|こうえん}: arena performance
